title_as_printed: Experimental Bunsen Solubility Coefficients for Hydrogen in Water and Seawater (beta in ml H2 (STP)/ml H2O)
pressure_note: Bunsen coefficient defined as the volume of gas (corrected to STP) absorbed in a unit volume of water at the measurement temperature when the partial pressure of the gas is 760 mm; measured pressure not tabulated
volume_basis_evidence: beta in ml H2 (STP)/ml H2O; 'absorbed in a unit volume of water at the measurement temperature'; Table I heading 'ml H2 (STP)/ml H2O'

composition.other_species: Salinity 0.0 = distilled water; 27.665, 33.680, 39.927 permil = seawater (diluted or boiled, salinity by induction salinometer); salinity unit printed as parts per thousand

skip_rows.reason: salinity label rows (salinity printed beside first printed row)

conversion_needs: partial pressure of 760 mm Hg = 1.01325 bar; salinity in permil of seawater needs ionic composition (sea salt), not NaCl
notes: Printed layout: two side-by-side halves (left: 0.0, 27.665, start of 33.680; right: rest of 33.680, 39.927), each printed row holding three (Temp, beta) pairs. Written as one row per (Temp, beta) pair: for each salinity block, printed rows in order, left pair to right pair; left half first, then right half. Salinity 33.680 therefore appears as two label rows (left then right half). Salinity 0.0 data are gas-in-distilled-water (composition none).
